entries.title: CLI: docs
entries.excerpt: Generate developer reference Markdown (alias: documentation)

entries.title: CLI: icons
entries.excerpt: Manage icon providers (list, add, remove, build)

entries.title: CLI: layout

entries.title: CLI: meta
entries.excerpt: Build Velin-Meta agent bundle; page --write merges curated goals/intent

entries.title: CLI: perf
entries.excerpt: Performance audit for images and scripts (directory or .html file)

entries.title: CLI: plan
entries.excerpt: Emit page plan JSON from a prompt (no HTML)

entries.excerpt: Add missing velin- prefix to classes (dry-run; use --write)

entries.title: CLI: review
entries.excerpt: Design / a11y / SEO / performance / conversion review gate

entries.title: CLI: scaffold
entries.excerpt: Plan-first page HTML or recipe fragment from natural language

entries.title: CLI: scan
entries.excerpt: Security, accessibility, CSS, and PII scanner (directory or single file)

entries.title: CLI: search
entries.excerpt: Build JSON search index for VelinSearch

entries.title: CLI: serve
entries.excerpt: Serve a directory over HTTP (default port 4173)

entries.title: CLI: skills
entries.excerpt: Registry-first AI skill catalog and install runner

entries.title: CLI: themes
entries.excerpt: List available built-in themes

entries.title: CLI: tokens
entries.excerpt: Build or validate design tokens JSON

entries.title: CLI: wc
entries.excerpt: Inspect Web Component APIs from source

entries.title: CLI: workflow
entries.excerpt: Resolve workflow graph or project workflow steps
